verdict.rationale: MailerSend's first-party docs describe an official MCP server at https://mcp.mailersend.com/mcp. Its MCP tools let AI assistants send emails and SMS and manage domains, templates, webhooks, suppressions, sender identities and users, and the llms.txt says it connects directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works, documented authentication/setup details beyond adding the remote URL

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This server enables AI assistants to send emails and SMS, manage domains, templates, webhooks, suppressions, sender identities, users, and many other things through standardized MCP tools.
Usually, you would just add `https://mcp.mailersend.com/mcp` as a remote MCP address in any tooling that you are working with.
Connect MailerSend directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini.
